In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the axial singlet matrix element and the quark spin content of the nucleon are still open questions.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the axial singlet matrix element is a very useful tool for studying the nucleon spin structure.
the axial singlet current is not conserved in the nucleon and the quark spin contribution is small.
the quark spin contribution to the nucleon spin is not necessarily small and that the nucleon spin problem is still far from being solved.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the axial singlet current is a useful tool to probe the nucleon structure and the axial charge of the nucleon.
the axial singlet matrix element is not a direct probe of the spin content of the nucleon.
the axial singlet current is not a good measure of the proton spin.
